method.transfer: Replay all 100 earlier measured plain replies, with one or four body paragraphs, as exact HTML paragraphs and a trailing blockquote. Alternate the two MIME encodings, retain explicit quote roles, and independently map decoded source characters.
method.evidence: Each HTML case must return the same ordered candidate inputs as its original measured plain reply. Use saved responses only on identical text and native input geometry.
method.controls: Use unsupported no-quote, interleaved, styled, unmarked, unbalanced and table variants on one genuine source of each body count. Require zero secondary-check admissions.
method.advance: Reproduce every admitted plain-reply location and genuine file flag, keep the one-paragraph four-sentence condition, and reproduce every decoded MIME range. This measures format transfer, with zero overall confidence weight.
